resources.string: Look up RDAP registration information. This does not test DNS, connectivity, ownership or purchase availability.
User-initiated external lookup. Results stay in memory; no lookup History is saved.

This query contacts an external registration service selected from the IANA directory. It can see the queried domain, your connection IP and necessary request metadata. An IANA directory refresh is also an external request. No LAN device lists, SSID/BSSID or diagnosis History are sent. Results stay in memory. Continue?
